title: pedilonum lankaviense
intro: Pedilonum lankaviense, commonly known as the Ceylon ash, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pedilonum lankaviense include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating various health conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for pain relief, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Pedilonum lankaviense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
